function spiralPath() { let d = ''; const n = 260; for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) { const t = k / n, r = 128 - 108 * t, a = -Math.PI / 2 + t * 3 * 2 * Math.PI; d += `${k ? 'L' : 'M'}${(150 + r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(1)} ${(150 + r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(1)} `; } return d; }
function renderSpiral() {
  const m = SP[spMode];
  $('#spiral').innerHTML = `<path id="spPath" class="sp" d="${spiralPath()}" stroke="${m.c}" opacity=".85"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="14" fill="${m.c}" opacity=".25"/>
    <text x="150" y="296" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="var(--muted)" font-family="var(--body)">${spMode === 'down' ? 'Empieza fuera y se va cerrando' : 'Empieza dentro y se va abriendo'}</text>
    <circle id="spBall" r="11" fill="${m.c}" stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  $('#spsteps').innerHTML = m.steps.map((s, i) => `<li style="--c:${m.c}"><i>${i + 1}</i>${s}</li>`).join('');
  const p = $('#spPath'), L = p.getTotalLength(), pt = p.getPointAtLength(spMode === 'down' ? 0 : L);
  $('#spBall').setAttribute('cx', pt.x); $('#spBall').setAttribute('cy', pt.y);
  $('#sDown').setAttribute('aria-pressed', spMode === 'down'); $('#sUp').setAttribute('aria-pressed', spMode === 'up');
}
function playSpiral() {
  if (spPlaying) return; spPlaying = true; const p = $('#spPath'), L = p.getTotalLength(), ball = $('#spBall'), lis = $$('#spsteps li'), DUR = 9000, t0 = performance.now();
  const step = (now) => { const u = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / DUR), s = spMode === 'down' ? u : 1 - u, pt = p.getPointAtLength(s * L);
    ball.setAttribute('cx', pt.x); ball.setAttribute('cy', pt.y); ball.setAttribute('r', spMode === 'down' ? 11 - u * 4 : 7 + u * 5);
    const k = Math.min(3, Math.floor((u * 3 * 4) % 4)); lis.forEach((l, j) => l.classList.toggle('on', j === k));
    if (u < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else { spPlaying = false; lis.forEach(l => l.classList.remove('on')); $('#sPlay').textContent = '↻ Otra vez'; toast(spMode === 'down' ? 'Ahora prueba «Hacia arriba»' : '¡Así se gira la espiral!'); } };
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
$('#sDown').onclick = () => { if (spPlaying) return; spMode = 'down'; renderSpiral(); $('#sPlay').textContent = '▶ Ver la espiral'; };
$('#sUp').onclick = () => { if (spPlaying) return; spMode = 'up'; renderSpiral(); $('#sPlay').textContent = '▶ Ver la espiral'; };
$('#sPlay').onclick = playSpiral;
renderSpiral();

  A.style.transition = B.style.transition = ''; $('#vA').textContent = 'Ánimo 2'; $('#vB').textContent = 'Ánimo 2'; $('#lanesMsg').hidden = true;
  $('#qA').textContent = 'Me quedo en el sofá hasta que me apetezca…'; $('#qB').textContent = 'Salgo 10 minutos aunque no me apetezca…';
  setTimeout(() => { A.style.height = '8%'; B.style.height = '52%'; $('#qA').textContent = 'Las ganas no llegan. Me siento culpable…'; $('#qB').textContent = 'Me da el aire. Algo cambia un poco.'; }, 300);
  setTimeout(() => { $('#vA').textContent = 'Ánimo 1'; $('#vB').textContent = 'Ánimo 5'; $('#qA').textContent = 'Sigo esperando.'; $('#qB').textContent = 'Ahora sí me apetece otra cosa pequeña.'; $('#lanesMsg').hidden = false; }, 3600);
};

let plan = store.get('plan', []); // {id, t, c, mini, day, mom, done, before, after, felt:[]}
const iso = (d) => { const z = new Date(d); z.setMinutes(z.getMinutes() - z.getTimezoneOffset()); return z.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };
const TODAY = iso(new Date());
let selDay = TODAY, adding = false, flowId = null, flow = {};
const DN = ['Dom', 'Lun', 'Mar', 'Mié', 'Jue', 'Vie', 'Sáb'];
const MOMS = ['Mañana', 'Mediodía', 'Tarde', 'Noche'];
function face(v, col = 'var(--up)') { const m = (v - 5) / 5; // -1..1
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="22" cy="22" r="20" fill="color-mix(in srgb, ${col} ${20 + v * 6}%, var(--surface))" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="15" cy="18" r="2.3" fill="var(--ink)"/><circle cx="29" cy="18" r="2.3" fill="var(--ink)"/><path d="M13 ${29 - m * 2} Q22 ${29 + m * 7} 31 ${29 - m * 2}" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`; }
const doneCount = () => plan.filter(p => p.done).length;
function plantSVG(n) {
  const h = Math.min(86, 18 + n * 6), top = 100 - h, leaves = Math.min(n, 12);
  let g = `<path d="M24 100h48l-6 18H30z" fill="var(--pot)"/><rect x="20" y="96" width="56" height="8" rx="3" fill="var(--pot)"/>`;
  g += `<path class="stem" d="M48 98 C 46 ${100 - h * .4}, 51 ${100 - h * .7}, 48 ${top}" stroke="var(--leaf)" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  for (let i = 0; i < leaves; i++) { const y = 94 - (i + 1) * (h - 8) / Math.max(leaves, 1) + 4, side = i % 2 ? 1 : -1, s = .75 + (i / 14);
    g += `<g transform="translate(48 ${y.toFixed(1)}) scale(${side * s} ${s})"><path class="lf" style="animation-delay:${i === leaves - 1 && plantSVG.fresh ? 0 : 0}s" d="M0 0 C 6 -10, 18 -10, 22 -4 C 16 2, 6 4, 0 0z" fill="${i % 3 ? 'var(--leaf)' : 'var(--leaf2)'}"/></g>`; }
  if (n >= 12) { const fl = Math.min(4, Math.floor((n - 10) / 2)); for (let k = 0; k < fl; k++) { const x = 48 + [0, -14, 14, 0][k], y = top + [0, 10, 12, -2][k];
    g += `<g class="lf"><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="6" fill="var(--up)"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="2.5" fill="var(--agr)"/></g>`; } }
  if (!n) g += `<circle cx="48" cy="96" r="4" fill="var(--leaf)"/>`;
  return g;
}
function streak() { let s = 0; const d = new Date(); for (;;) { const k = iso(d); if (plan.some(p => p.done && p.day === k)) { s++; d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); } else if (k === TODAY) { d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); } else break; } return s; }
function renderPlant() { const n = doneCount(); $('#plant').innerHTML = plantSVG(n);
  $('#plantT').textContent = n ? (n < 12 ? `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'hoja' : 'hojas'}` : '¡Está floreciendo!') : 'Tu planta';
  const st = streak(); $('#plantS').innerHTML = n ? `Cada actividad que haces le da una hoja nueva.${st > 1 ? ` Llevas <b>${st} días</b> seguidos haciendo algo.` : ''}` : 'Crece con cada actividad que hagas, por pequeña que sea.'; }
function renderDays() {
  const d0 = new Date(); d0.setDate(d0.getDate() - 1); let h = '';
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const d = new Date(d0); d.setDate(d0.getDate() + k); const key = iso(d), items = plan.filter(p => p.day === key);
    h += `<button class="day" data-day="${key}" aria-pressed="${key === selDay}"><span>${key === TODAY ? 'Hoy' : DN[d.getDay()]}</span><b>${d.getDate()}</b><span class="dots">${items.slice(0, 4).map(p => `<i class="${p.done ? 'd' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</span></button>`; }
  $('#days').innerHTML = h; $$('[data-day]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { selDay = b.dataset.day; adding = false; flowId = null; renderWeek(); });
}
function renderDay() {
  const items = plan.filter(p => p.day === selDay).sort((a, b) => MOMS.indexOf(a.mom) - MOMS.indexOf(b.mom)), past = selDay < TODAY;
  const lbl = selDay === TODAY ? 'Hoy' : new Date(selDay + 'T12:00').toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  let h = `<div class="nav-row"><h2 style="text-transform:capitalize">${lbl}</h2>${!adding ? `<button class="btn small" id="addBtn">+ Planificar</button>` : ''}</div>`;
  if (adding) h += addSheet();
  if (!items.length && !adding) h += `<div class="empty">Nada planificado. ${menu.length ? 'Elige 1 o 2 cosas pequeñas de tu menú.' : 'Primero elige algunas actividades en <b>Mi menú</b>.'}</div>`;
  h += items.map(itemHTML).join('');
  if (items.length >= 4 && !adding) h += `<div class="note small">Ya tienes ${items.length}. Con el ánimo bajo, menos es más: mejor 2 hechas que 5 pendientes.</div>`;
  $('#dayBox').innerHTML = h; bindDay();
}
let addSel = null, addMom = 'Mañana';
function addSheet() {
  const src = menu.length ? menu : ACTS.filter(a => a[2] === 1).map(a => ({ t: a[0], c: a[1], lv: a[2], mini: a[3] }));
  return `<div class="sheet"><span class="lbl">¿Qué vas a hacer?</span>${menu.length ? '' : '<p class="small muted">Aún no tienes menú: aquí van algunas fáciles.</p>'}
    <div class="chips">${src.map(m => `<button class="act" style="--c:${CATS[m.c][1]}" data-pick="${esc(m.t)}" aria-pressed="${addSel === m.t}">${esc(m.t)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <span class="lbl">¿Cuándo?</span><div class="chips">${MOMS.map(m => `<button class="chip" data-mom="${m}" aria-pressed="${addMom === m}">${m}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="nav-row"><button class="btn link" id="addCancel">Cancelar</button><button class="btn" id="addOk" ${addSel ? '' : 'disabled'}>Añadir</button></div></div>`;
}
function itemHTML(p) {
  const c = CATS[p.c][1];
  let h = `<div class="item ${p.done ? 'done' : ''} pop" style="--c:${c}"><div class="row"><div class="stack" style="gap:0"><span class="mom">${p.mom} · ${CATS[p.c][0]}</span><span class="t">${p.done ? '✓ ' : ''}${esc(p.t)}</span>${p.mini && !p.done ? `<span class="mini">Si cuesta: ${esc(p.mini)}</span>` : ''}</div>
    ${p.done ? `<span class="delta" style="color:${p.after - p.before >= 0 ? 'var(--up)' : 'var(--down)'}">${p.before} → ${p.after}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
  if (flowId === p.id) h += flowHTML(p);
  else if (!p.done) h += `<div class="nav-row"><button class="btn small" data-start="${p.id}">Empezar</button><span style="display:flex;gap:4px"><button class="btn link small" data-move="${p.id}">Pasar a mañana</button><button class="btn link small" data-del="${p.id}" aria-label="Quitar">✕</button></span></div>`;
  return h + '</div>';
}
function flowHTML(p) {
  if (flow.stage === 0) return `<div class="flow"><span class="lbl">¿Cómo está tu ánimo ahora?</span>${moodRow('fb', flow.before)}
    <div class="nav-row"><button class="btn ghost small" id="f5">Solo 5 minutos</button><button class="btn small" id="fGo">Lo hago</button></div>
    <p class="small muted">«Solo 5 minutos»: empieza con un temporizador. Si después quieres parar, paras. Ya cuenta.</p></div>`;
  if (flow.stage === 1) return `<div class="flow"><div class="timer5"><svg viewBox="0 0 70 70"><circle cx="35" cy="35" r="29" fill="none" stroke="var(--tint)" stroke-width="7"/><circle id="t5" cx="35" cy="35" r="29" fill="none" stroke="var(--up)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="182.2" stroke-dashoffset="0" transform="rotate(-90 35 35)"/><text id="t5t" x="35" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="var(--deep)" font-family="var(--body)">5:00</text></svg><p class="small">Ahora, solo esto: <b>${esc((p.mini || p.t).replace(/\.$/, ''))}</b>. No hace falta que te apetezca.</p></div><button class="btn small" id="fDone">Ya lo he hecho</button></div>`;
  return `<div class="flow"><span class="lbl">¡Hecho! ¿Y ahora, cómo está tu ánimo?</span>${moodRow('fa', flow.after)}
    <span class="lbl">¿Qué te ha dado?</span><div class="chips">${[['Agrado', 'var(--agr)'], ['Logro', 'var(--log)'], ['Conexión', 'var(--con)'], ['Energía', 'var(--cue)'], ['Nada especial', 'var(--muted)']].map(([f, c]) => `<button class="chip" style="--c:${c}" data-felt="${f}" aria-pressed="${(flow.felt || []).includes(f)}">${f}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="small muted">Aunque el ánimo no cambie mucho, <b>lo has hecho</b>. Eso ya es girar la espiral.</div>
    <button class="btn small" id="fSave">Guardar</button></div>`;
}
const moodRow = (id, v) => `<div class="mood"><span id="${id}F">${face(v)}</span><input type="range" min="0" max="10" value="${v}" id="${id}" aria-label="Ánimo de 0 a 10"><span class="n" id="${id}N">${v}</span></div>`;
let t5iv = null;
function bindDay() {
  const ab = $('#addBtn'); if (ab) ab.onclick = () => { adding = true; addSel = null; renderDay(); };
  $$('[data-pick]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { addSel = b.dataset.pick; renderDay(); });
  $$('[data-mom]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { addMom = b.dataset.mom; renderDay(); });
  const ac = $('#addCancel'); if (ac) ac.onclick = () => { adding = false; renderDay(); };
  const ao = $('#addOk'); if (ao) ao.onclick = () => { const src = menu.find(m => m.t === addSel) || (() => { const a = ACTS.find(x => x[0] === addSel); return { t: a[0], c: a[1], mini: a[3] }; })();
    plan.push({ id: Date.now(), t: src.t, c: src.c, mini: src.mini, day: selDay, mom: addMom, done: false }); store.set('plan', plan); adding = false; renderWeek(); toast('Planificado'); };
  $$('[data-start]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { flowId = +b.dataset.start; flow = { stage: 0, before: 3, after: 3, felt: [] }; renderDay(); });
  $$('[data-move]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const p = plan.find(x => x.id === +b.dataset.move), d = new Date(p.day + 'T12:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1); p.day = iso(d); store.set('plan', plan); renderWeek(); toast('Pasada al día siguiente. Sin culpa.'); });
  $$('[data-del]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { plan = plan.filter(x => x.id !== +b.dataset.del); store.set('plan', plan); renderWeek(); });
  ['fb', 'fa'].forEach(id => { const r = $('#' + id); if (r) r.oninput = () => { const v = +r.value; $('#' + id + 'N').textContent = v; $('#' + id + 'F').innerHTML = face(v); if (id === 'fb') flow.before = v; else flow.after = v; }; });
  const go = $('#fGo'); if (go) go.onclick = () => { flow.stage = 2; flow.after = flow.before; renderDay(); };
  const f5 = $('#f5'); if (f5) f5.onclick = () => { flow.stage = 1; renderDay(); const t0 = Date.now(), T = 300000; clearInterval(t5iv);
    t5iv = setInterval(() => { const el = Date.now() - t0, left = Math.max(0, T - el), c = $('#t5'); if (!c) { clearInterval(t5iv); return; }
      c.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', 182.2 * el / T); $('#t5t').textContent = Math.floor(left / 60000) + ':' + String(Math.floor(left % 60000 / 1000)).padStart(2, '0');
      if (!left) { clearInterval(t5iv); toast('¡5 minutos! Puedes parar o seguir.'); } }, 250); };
  const fd = $('#fDone'); if (fd) fd.onclick = () => { clearInterval(t5iv); flow.stage = 2; flow.after = flow.before; renderDay(); };
  $$('[data-felt]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const f = b.dataset.felt; flow.felt = flow.felt.includes(f) ? flow.felt.filter(x => x !== f) : [...flow.felt, f]; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', flow.felt.includes(f)); });
  const fs = $('#fSave'); if (fs) fs.onclick = () => { const p = plan.find(x => x.id === flowId); Object.assign(p, { done: true, before: flow.before, after: flow.after, felt: flow.felt, doneAt: Date.now() });
    store.set('plan', plan); flowId = null; burst(); renderWeek(); toast('¡Una hoja nueva!'); };
}
function burst() { if (reduce) return; const b = document.createElement('div'); b.className = 'burst'; const r = $('#plant').getBoundingClientRect(), cx = r.left + r.width / 2, cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
  const cols = ['var(--leaf)', 'var(--leaf2)', 'var(--up)', 'var(--agr)'];
  b.innerHTML = Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => { const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, d = 60 + Math.random() * 90; return `<i style="left:${cx}px;top:${Math.max(40, cy)}px;background:${cols[i % 4]};--dx:${Math.cos(a) * d}px;--dy:${Math.sin(a) * d - 40}px;--r:${Math.random() * 360}deg"></i>`; }).join('');
  document.body.appendChild(b); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); setTimeout(() => b.remove(), 1500); }
function renderWeek() { renderPlant(); renderDays(); renderDay(); }

/* ================= PROGRESO ================= */
function renderProg() {
  const done = plan.filter(p => p.done).sort((a, b) => (a.doneAt || 0) - (b.doneAt || 0));
  const avgD = done.length ? done.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.after - p.before), 0) / done.length : 0, up = done.filter(p => p.after > p.before).length;
  $('#stats').innerHTML = `<div class="stat"><b>${done.length}</b><span>actividades hechas</span></div><div class="stat"><b style="color:var(--up)">${avgD > 0 ? '+' : ''}${avgD.toFixed(1).replace('.', ',')}</b><span>cambio medio de ánimo</span></div><div class="stat"><b>${done.length ? Math.round(up / done.length * 100) : 0}%</b><span>veces que subió el ánimo</span></div>`;
  if (!done.length) { $('#dumb').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Aquí aparecerán tus actividades cuando marques la primera como hecha.</div>'; $('#top3').innerHTML = '<p class="small muted">Aún no hay datos.</p>'; $('#daysChart').innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const last = done.slice(-10), W = 320, rowH = 26, H = last.length * rowH + 26, l = 116, r = 12, x = (v) => l + v * (W - l - r) / 10;
  let g = [0, 5, 10].map(v => `<line x1="${x(v)}" x2="${x(v)}" y1="4" y2="${H - 18}" stroke="var(--line)"/><text x="${x(v)}" y="${H - 4}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${v}</text>`).join('');
  last.forEach((p, i) => { const y = 16 + i * rowH, nm = p.t.length > 19 ? p.t.slice(0, 18) + '…' : p.t, c = p.after >= p.before ? 'var(--up)' : 'var(--down)';
    g += `<text x="${l - 8}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="var(--ink)">${esc(nm)}</text><line x1="${x(p.before)}" x2="${x(p.after)}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="${x(p.before)}" cy="${y}" r="5" fill="var(--muted)" opacity=".6"/><circle cx="${x(p.after)}" cy="${y}" r="6" fill="${c}"/>`; });
  $('#dumb').innerHTML = `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Ánimo antes y después de cada actividad">${g}</svg>`;
  const by = {}; done.forEach(p => { (by[p.t] = by[p.t] || []).push(p.after - p.before); });
  const tops = Object.entries(by).map(([t, ds]) => [t, ds.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / ds.length, ds.length]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 4), mx = Math.max(1, ...tops.map(t => t[1]));
  $('#top3').innerHTML = tops.map(([t, d, n]) => `<div><span>${esc(t)} <span class="muted small">· ${n} ${n === 1 ? 'vez' : 'veces'}</span></span><b style="color:var(--up)">${d > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.toFixed(1).replace('.', ',')}</b><span class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.max(4, d / mx * 100)}%"></i></span></div>`).join('') + '<p class="small muted">Tenlas a mano para los días difíciles.</p>';
  const days = []; for (let k = 13; k >= 0; k--) { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - k); const key = iso(d), ps = done.filter(p => p.day === key); days.push([d, ps.length, ps.length ? ps.reduce((s, p) => s + p.after, 0) / ps.length : null]); }
  const W2 = 320, H2 = 140, b2 = 20, t2 = 10, cw = (W2 - 20) / 14, mxN = Math.max(3, ...days.map(d => d[1])), y2 = (v) => t2 + (10 - v) * (H2 - t2 - b2) / 10;
  let g2 = days.map(([d, n], i) => `<rect x="${10 + i * cw + 3}" y="${H2 - b2 - n / mxN * (H2 - t2 - b2) * .7}" width="${cw - 6}" height="${n / mxN * (H2 - t2 - b2) * .7}" rx="4" fill="var(--leaf)" opacity=".55"/><text x="${10 + i * cw + cw / 2}" y="${H2 - 6}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${d.getDate()}</text>`).join('');
  const pts = days.map((d, i) => d[2] === null ? null : [10 + i * cw + cw / 2, y2(d[2])]).filter(Boolean);
  if (pts.length) g2 += `<path d="${pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="var(--up)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>` + pts.map(p => `<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="4" fill="var(--up)"/>`).join('');
  $('#daysChart').innerHTML = `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W2} ${H2}" role="img" aria-label="Actividades y ánimo de los últimos 14 días">${g2}</svg>`;
}
function summary() {
  const done = plan.filter(p => p.done), L = ['Ponerme en marcha: resumen', `Actividades hechas: ${done.length}`];
  if (menu.length) L.push('Mi menú: ' + menu.map(m => m.t).join(', '));
  done.slice(-12).forEach(p => L.push(`- ${new Date(p.day + 'T12:00').toLocaleDateString('es-ES')} ${p.t}: ánimo ${p.before} → ${p.after}${p.felt && p.felt.length ? ' (' + p.felt.join(', ') + ')' : ''}`));
  const pend = plan.filter(p => !p.done && p.day < TODAY).length; if (pend) L.push(`Planificadas que no salieron: ${pend}`);
  return L.join('\n');
}
$('#copyBtn').onclick = () => { const txt = summary(); const fb = () => { const t = $('#copyFallback'); t.value = txt; t.hidden = false; t.focus(); t.select(); toast('Selecciona y copia el texto'); setTimeout(() => t.hidden = true, 15000); };
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => toast('Copiado. Pégalo en un mensaje.'), fb); } catch (e) { fb(); } };

function switchTab(v) {
  $$('nav.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x.dataset.view === v)); $$('section.view').forEach(s => s.hidden = s.id !== 'view-' + v);
  if (v === 'men') renderMenu(); if (v === 'hoy') renderWeek(); if (v === 'pro') renderProg();
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
}
$$('nav.tabs button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => switchTab(b.dataset.view));
</script>

function cycleSVG(id, opts = {}) {
  const fearR = opts.fear ?? 26, lifeR = opts.life ?? 172, labels = opts.labels;
  let g = `<circle class="lifering" id="${id}-life" cx="${CX}" cy="${CY}" r="${lifeR}" fill="var(--life)" opacity=".28"/>`;
  g += `<text x="${CX}" y="${CY + lifeR - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="var(--muted)" font-family="var(--body)" font-weight="700" id="${id}-lifet" letter-spacing="1">MI VIDA</text>`;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a0 = ang(i) + .36, a1 = ang(i + 1) - .36;
    const x0 = CX + R * Math.cos(a0), y0 = CY + R * Math.sin(a0), x1 = CX + R * Math.cos(a1), y1 = CY + R * Math.sin(a1);
    g += `<path class="flow" d="M${x0.toFixed(1)} ${y0.toFixed(1)} A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${x1.toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)}" stroke="${NODES[i].c}" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".8"/>`;
    const ah = a1, ax = x1, ay = y1, tx = -Math.sin(ah), ty = Math.cos(ah);
    g += `<path d="M${(ax - tx * 9 + Math.cos(ah) * 6).toFixed(1)} ${(ay - ty * 9 + Math.sin(ah) * 6).toFixed(1)} L${ax.toFixed(1)} ${ay.toFixed(1)} L${(ax - tx * 9 - Math.cos(ah) * 6).toFixed(1)} ${(ay - ty * 9 - Math.sin(ah) * 6).toFixed(1)}" fill="none" stroke="${NODES[i].c}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
  }
  g += `<circle class="fearblob" id="${id}-fear" cx="${CX}" cy="${CY}" r="${fearR}" fill="var(--fear)" opacity=".85"/><text class="ftext" x="${CX}" y="${CY + 4}" text-anchor="middle">miedo</text>`;
  NODES.forEach((n, i) => { const [x, y] = pos(i);
    g += `<g class="node" data-node="${i}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${n.title}"><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="38" fill="${n.c}"/>
      <text class="nnum" x="${x}" y="${y - 14}" text-anchor="middle">${i + 1}</text>
      ${labels ? `<text class="ntext" x="${x}" y="${y + 3}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(labels[i][0])}</text><text class="ntext" x="${x}" y="${y + 15}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(labels[i][1] || '')}</text>`
        : `<text class="ntext" x="${x}" y="${y + 3}" text-anchor="middle">${n.t[0]}</text><text class="ntext" x="${x}" y="${y + 15}" text-anchor="middle">${n.t[1]}</text>`}</g>`; });
  const [ax, ay] = pos(3, R + 46); const fx = Math.max(44, ax), fy = ay + 22;
  g += `<text class="flash" id="${id}-flash" x="${fx}" y="${fy}" text-anchor="middle">¡Uf, alivio!</text>`;
  g += `<circle id="${id}-dot" r="9" fill="var(--deep)" stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="3" cx="${pos(0)[0]}" cy="${pos(0)[1]}" opacity="0"/>`;
  return `<svg class="cycle" viewBox="0 0 360 370" role="img" aria-label="Círculo de mantenimiento del miedo en cinco pasos">${g}</svg>`;
}

  $('#infoA').innerHTML = `<div class="info" style="--c:${n.c}"><h2>${n.title}</h2><p>${n.txt}</p>${i < 4 ? `<button class="btn link small" id="nextNode" style="align-self:flex-end">Siguiente paso →</button>` : ''}</div>`;

let playing = false;
function play(id, lapEl, onEnd) {
  if (playing) return; playing = true;
  const dot = document.getElementById(id + '-dot'), fear = document.getElementById(id + '-fear'), life = document.getElementById(id + '-life'), lifet = document.getElementById(id + '-lifet'), fl = document.getElementById(id + '-flash');
  dot.setAttribute('opacity', 1); let lap = 0; const LAPS = 3, DUR = 5200; let t0 = performance.now(), lastNode = -1;
  const msgs = ['Vuelta 1: evitar trae alivio…', 'Vuelta 2: pero el miedo vuelve, más grande.', 'Vuelta 3: cada vez evitas más, y tu vida se hace más pequeña.'];
  const step = (now) => {
    const el = now - t0, lp = Math.floor(el / DUR);
    if (lp >= LAPS) { dot.setAttribute('opacity', 0); highlight(id.replace('c', 'cycle'), null); lapEl.innerHTML = 'Así se mantiene el miedo: <b>el alivio de hoy es el miedo de mañana</b>.'; playing = false; onEnd && onEnd(); return; }
    if (lp !== lap) { lap = lp; }
    const u = (el % DUR) / DUR, a = -Math.PI / 2 + u * 2 * Math.PI;
    dot.setAttribute('cx', CX + R * Math.cos(a)); dot.setAttribute('cy', CY + R * Math.sin(a));
    const ni = Math.min(4, Math.floor(((u + .1) % 1) * 5));
    if (ni !== lastNode) { lastNode = ni; document.querySelectorAll(`#${id === 'cA' ? 'cycleA' : 'cycleM'} .node`).forEach((n, k) => { n.classList.toggle('on', k === ni); n.classList.remove('dim'); });
      if (ni === 3) { fl.classList.remove('go'); void fl.getBBox(); fl.classList.add('go'); }
      if (ni === 4) { fear.setAttribute('r', 26 + (lap + 1) * 13); life.setAttribute('r', 172 - (lap + 1) * 18); lifet.setAttribute('y', CY + (172 - (lap + 1) * 18) - 8); lifet.setAttribute('opacity', lap >= 1 ? 0 : 1); } }
    lapEl.textContent = msgs[lap];
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  fear.setAttribute('r', 26); life.setAttribute('r', 172); lifet.setAttribute('y', CY + 172 - 8); lifet.setAttribute('opacity', 1);
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

// gráfico
let gMode = 'ev';
function graphSVG(mode) {
  const W = 320, H = 170, l = 26, b = 22, t = 10, x = (v) => l + v * (W - l - 10) / 30, y = (v) => t + (10 - v) * (H - t - b) / 10;
  let g = ''; [0, 5, 10].forEach(v => g += `<line x1="${l}" x2="${W - 10}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="var(--line)"/><text x="${l - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${v}</text>`);
  g += `<text x="${W - 10}" y="${t + 8}" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">ansiedad</text>`;
  let d = '', marks = '';
  if (mode === 'ev') {
    const peaks = [7, 8.3, 9.5];
    peaks.forEach((p, k) => { const s = k * 10; d += `${k ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(s)} ${y(1.5 + k * .8)} C${x(s + 2)} ${y(1.5 + k)} ${x(s + 3)} ${y(p)} ${x(s + 4)} ${y(p)} L${x(s + 4.6)} ${y(1.2 + k * .8)} L${x(s + 9.6)} ${y(1.5 + (k + 1) * .8)} `;
      marks += `<text x="${x(s + 4.4)}" y="${y(p) - 6}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="var(--fear)">evito</text><path d="M${x(s + 4.3)} ${y(p - 1)}l4 8" stroke="var(--n4)" stroke-width="2"/><text x="${x(s + 6.5)}" y="${y(1.4 + k * .8) + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="var(--n4)">alivio</text>`; });
  } else {
    const peaks = [7, 5.2, 3.4];
    peaks.forEach((p, k) => { const s = k * 10; d += `${k ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(s)} ${y(1.5)} C${x(s + 2)} ${y(1.5)} ${x(s + 2.5)} ${y(p)} ${x(s + 3.5)} ${y(p)} C${x(s + 5)} ${y(p)} ${x(s + 7)} ${y(1.6)} ${x(s + 9.6)} ${y(1.5)} `;
      marks += `<text x="${x(s + 3.5)}" y="${y(p) - 6}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="var(--n4)">me quedo</text>`; });
  }
  [0, 1, 2].forEach(k => g += `<text x="${x(k * 10 + 5)}" y="${H - 4}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${k + 1}ª vez</text>`);
  return `<svg class="graph" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Ansiedad en el tiempo ${mode === 'ev' ? 'si evito' : 'si me quedo'}">${g}<path class="curve draw" d="${d}" stroke="${mode === 'ev' ? 'var(--fear)' : 'var(--n4)'}"/>${marks}</svg>`;
}

function short(s) { s = String(s || ''); return s.length > 15 ? s.slice(0, 14) + '…' : s; }
function renderM() {
  $('#mDots').innerHTML = MS.map((_, i) => `<span class="${i <= mScr ? 'on' : ''}" style="${i <= mScr ? `background:${NODES[Math.min(i, 4)].c}` : ''}"></span>`).join('');
  $('#mScreen').innerHTML = MS[mScr].r(); MS[mScr].a && MS[mScr].a(); $('#mErr').hidden = true;
  $('#mPrev').style.visibility = mScr ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
  $('#mNext').textContent = mScr === MS.length - 2 ? 'Ver mi círculo' : mScr === MS.length - 1 ? 'Ir a Salir del círculo' : 'Siguiente';
}
$('#mPrev').onclick = () => { if (mScr) { mScr--; renderM(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); } };
$('#mNext').onclick = () => { const c = MS[mScr].c ? MS[mScr].c() : ''; if (c) { $('#mErr').textContent = c; $('#mErr').hidden = false; return; }
  if (mScr < MS.length - 1) { mScr++; renderM(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); } else switchTab('sal'); };

const fearCol = (f) => f <= 3 ? 'var(--n4)' : f <= 6 ? 'var(--n1)' : 'var(--n2)';
function renderLadder() {
  const sorted = L.map((r, i) => ({ ...r, i })).sort((a, b) => a.f - b.f);
  $('#ladder').innerHTML = sorted.length ? sorted.map((r, k) => `<div class="rung ${r.done ? 'done' : ''}" style="--c:${fearCol(r.f)}"><span class="n">${k + 1}</span><span class="t">${esc(r.t)}</span><span style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><span class="fearv">${r.f}</span><button data-dn="${r.i}" aria-label="Marcar como superado" title="Superado">${r.done ? '↺' : '✓'}</button><button data-rm="${r.i}" aria-label="Quitar">×</button></span></div>`).join('')
    : '<div class="empty">Tu escalera está vacía. Añade la primera situación.</div>';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-dn]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { L[+b.dataset.dn].done = !L[+b.dataset.dn].done; store.set('ladder', L); renderLadder(); renderSel(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-rm]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { L.splice(+b.dataset.rm, 1); store.set('ladder', L); renderLadder(); renderSel(); });
}
$('#rAdd').onclick = () => { const t = $('#rT').value.trim(); const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, +$('#rF').value || 0)); if (!t) return; L.push({ t, f, done: false }); store.set('ladder', L); $('#rT').value = ''; renderLadder(); renderSel(); };
$('#rT').onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') $('#rAdd').click(); };
function renderCrutch() {
  const mine = M.crutch || (M.avoid.includes('muletas') ? 'mis muletas' : '');
  $('#crutches').innerHTML = mine ? `<div class="note">Tu muleta: <b>${esc(mine)}</b>. Prueba a reducirla un poco en cada práctica: dejarla en el coche, luego en casa…</div>` : '<p class="small muted">Si en «Mi círculo» marcas «Ir con muletas», aquí verás la tuya.</p>';
}
let cur = null;
function renderSel() { const open = L.map((r, i) => ({ ...r, i })).filter(r => !r.done).sort((a, b) => a.f - b.f);
  $('#pSel').innerHTML = open.length ? `<span class="lbl">¿Qué vas a practicar?</span><div class="chips">${open.map(r => `<button class="chip" style="--c:var(--accent)" data-ps="${r.i}" aria-pressed="${cur === r.i}">${esc(r.t)} · ${r.f}</button>`).join('')}</div>` : '<p class="small muted">Añade situaciones a tu escalera para elegir una. También puedes practicar sin elegir.</p>';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ps]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { cur = +b.dataset.ps; renderSel(); }); }

let pts = [], t0 = 0, iv = null;
function liveSVG(arr, W = 320, H = 170, mini) {
  const l = mini ? 4 : 26, b = mini ? 4 : 22, t = mini ? 4 : 10, maxT = Math.max(arr.length ? arr[arr.length - 1][0] : 0, mini ? 1 : 300);
  const x = (s) => l + s * (W - l - 10) / maxT, y = (v) => t + (10 - v) * (H - t - b) / 10;
  let g = mini ? '' : [0, 5, 10].map(v => `<line x1="${l}" x2="${W - 10}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="var(--line)"/><text x="${l - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${v}</text>`).join('') + `<text x="${W - 10}" y="${H - 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">minutos →</text>`;
  if (arr.length) { const d = arr.map(([s, v], i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(s).toFixed(1)} ${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
    g += `<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(--fear)" stroke-width="${mini ? 2.5 : 3.5}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
    if (!mini) g += arr.map(([s, v]) => `<circle cx="${x(s)}" cy="${y(v)}" r="4" fill="var(--fear)"/>`).join(''); }
  else if (!mini) g += `<text x="${W / 2}" y="${H / 2}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="var(--muted)">Aquí se dibujará tu curva</text>`;
  return g;
}
const fmt = (s) => Math.floor(s / 60) + ':' + String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0');
$('#live').innerHTML = liveSVG([]);
$('#pF').oninput = (e) => $('#pFV').textContent = e.target.value;
const mark = () => { const s = Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 1000); pts.push([s, +$('#pF').value]); $('#live').innerHTML = liveSVG(pts); };
$('#pGo').onclick = () => { pts = []; t0 = performance.now(); mark(); $('#pGo').hidden = true; $('#pMark').hidden = false; $('#pStop').hidden = false; $('#pMsg').hidden = true;
  let lastAuto = 0;
  iv = setInterval(() => { const s = Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 1000); $('#pT').textContent = fmt(s); if (s - lastAuto >= 60) { lastAuto = s; mark(); } }, 500); };
$('#pMark').onclick = mark;
$('#pStop').onclick = () => { clearInterval(iv); mark(); $('#pGo').hidden = false; $('#pGo').textContent = 'Otra práctica'; $('#pMark').hidden = true; $('#pStop').hidden = true;
  const max = Math.max(...pts.map(p => p[1])), end = pts[pts.length - 1][1], s = pts[pts.length - 1][0];
  $('#pMsg').hidden = false; $('#pMsg').innerHTML = end < max ? `Tu miedo subió hasta <b>${max}</b> y bajó a <b>${end}</b> sin escapar. Eso es tu cuerpo aprendiendo que puede.` : `Te quedaste ${fmt(s)}. A veces la curva tarda más en bajar: la próxima vez, intenta quedarte un poco más.`;
  P.push({ t: Date.now(), sit: cur !== null && L[cur] ? L[cur].t : 'Práctica libre', pts, max, end, dur: s }); store.set('pracs', P); renderPracs(); };
function renderPracs() {
  $('#pracs').innerHTML = P.length ? P.slice().reverse().slice(0, 12).map(p => `<div class="prac"><b>${esc(p.sit)}</b><span class="small muted">${new Date(p.t).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} · ${fmt(p.dur)} · miedo ${p.max} → ${p.end}</span><svg viewBox="0 0 320 60" preserveAspectRatio="none">${liveSVG(p.pts, 320, 60, true)}</svg></div>`).join('')
    : '<div class="empty">Tus prácticas aparecerán aquí con su curva.</div>';
}
function summary() {
  const av = M.avoid.map(k => AVOID.find(a => a[0] === k)[1]);
  const Ls = ['El círculo del miedo: resumen', `Situación: ${M.sitTxt || M.sit || '—'}`, `Reacción: ${[...M.body, ...M.thoughts].join(', ') || '—'}`, `Evitación: ${av.join(', ') || '—'}${M.crutch ? ' (' + M.crutch + ')' : ''}`, `Alivio: ${M.relief.join(', ') || '—'}`, `Coste: ${M.cost.join(', ') || '—'}`];
  if (L.length) Ls.push('Mi escalera: ' + L.slice().sort((a, b) => a.f - b.f).map(r => `${r.t} (${r.f})${r.done ? ' ✓' : ''}`).join('; '));
  P.slice(-8).forEach(p => Ls.push(`- ${new Date(p.t).toLocaleDateString('es-ES')} ${p.sit}: ${fmt(p.dur)}, miedo ${p.max}→${p.end}`));
  return Ls.join('\n');
}
$('#copyBtn').onclick = () => { const txt = summary(); const fb = () => { const t = $('#copyFallback'); t.value = txt; t.hidden = false; t.focus(); t.select(); toast('Selecciona y copia el texto'); setTimeout(() => t.hidden = true, 15000); };
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => toast('Copiado. Pégalo en un mensaje.'), fb); } catch (e) { fb(); } };

(() => { const inweb = /gracielasalvador|vercel/.test(location.hostname) || /\/herramientas\//.test(location.pathname);
  if (inweb) { const b = $('#calmaRef'); b.outerHTML = '<a href="../calma/" style="color:inherit;font-weight:700">Calmarme o volver a mí</a>'; } })();
function switchTab(v) { document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x.dataset.view === v)); document.querySelectorAll('section.view').forEach(s => s.hidden = s.id !== 'view-' + v);
  if (v === 'mio') renderM(); if (v === 'sal') { renderLadder(); renderCrutch(); renderSel(); renderPracs(); } window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); }
document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => switchTab(b.dataset.view));

  PHASES.forEach(([n], i) => { const cls = i < ph ? 'on' : i === ph ? 'cur' : '';
    g += `<circle class="node ${cls}" cx="${xs[i]}" cy="${ys[i]}" r="${i === ph ? 9 : 7}"/><text x="${xs[i]}" y="${ys[i] + 26}" text-anchor="middle" class="${i <= ph ? 'on' : ''}">${n}</text>`; });
  return `<svg class="method" viewBox="0 0 340 64" role="img" aria-label="Fase ${ph + 1} de 4: ${PHASES[ph][0]}">${g}</svg>`;
}

// ----- Rueda -----
function wheelSVG() {
  const cx = 150, cy = 150, R = 140, r = 52, n = ORDER.length;
  let g = '';
  ORDER.forEach((k, i) => {
    const a0 = (i / n) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2 - Math.PI / n, a1 = ((i + 1) / n) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2 - Math.PI / n;
    const p = (rr, a) => [cx + rr * Math.cos(a), cy + rr * Math.sin(a)];
    const [x0, y0] = p(R, a0), [x1, y1] = p(R, a1), [x2, y2] = p(r, a1), [x3, y3] = p(r, a0);
    const sel = d.emos.includes(k), dim = d.emos.length && !sel;
    g += `<path d="M${x0.toFixed(1)} ${y0.toFixed(1)} A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${x1.toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)} L${x2.toFixed(1)} ${y2.toFixed(1)} A${r} ${r} 0 0 0 ${x3.toFixed(1)} ${y3.toFixed(1)}Z" fill="var(--e-${k})" class="${sel ? 'sel' : ''} ${dim ? 'dim' : ''}" data-wemo="${k}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-pressed="${sel}" aria-label="${EMO[k].name}"/>`;
    const [tx, ty] = p((R + r) / 2, (a0 + a1) / 2);
    g += `<text x="${tx.toFixed(1)}" y="${(ty + 4).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle">${EMO[k].name}</text>`;
  });
  g += `<circle class="hub" cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r - 4}"/><text class="hubt" x="${cx}" y="${cy - 3}" text-anchor="middle">¿Qué</text><text class="hubt" x="${cx}" y="${cy + 15}" text-anchor="middle">sientes?</text>`;
  return `<svg class="wheel" viewBox="0 0 300 300">${g}</svg>`;
}

// ----- Silueta -----

  const on = (z) => d.zones.includes(z) ? 'on' : '';
  return `<svg class="bodyfig" viewBox="0 0 150 280" role="group" aria-label="Silueta: toca dónde lo notas">
    <circle class="z ${on('Cabeza')}" data-zone="Cabeza" cx="75" cy="32" r="24"/>
    <rect class="z ${on('Garganta')}" data-zone="Garganta" x="65" y="56" width="20" height="14" rx="4"/>
    <path class="z ${on('Hombros')}" data-zone="Hombros" d="M30 86c0-10 18-16 45-16s45 6 45 16v6H30z"/>
    <rect class="z ${on('Pecho')}" data-zone="Pecho" x="44" y="92" width="62" height="40" rx="10"/>
    <rect class="z ${on('Estómago')}" data-zone="Estómago" x="46" y="134" width="58" height="40" rx="12"/>
    <path class="z ${on('Brazos y manos')}" data-zone="Brazos y manos" d="M22 92h18v70a9 9 0 0 1-18 0zM110 92h18v70a9 9 0 0 1-18 0z"/>
    <path class="z ${on('Piernas')}" data-zone="Piernas" d="M48 176h24v92a12 12 0 0 1-24 0zM78 176h24v92a12 12 0 0 1-24 0z"/>
  </svg>`;
}

function render() {
  $('#method').innerHTML = methodSVG();
  $('#screen').innerHTML = SCREENS[scr].render();
  SCREENS[scr].after && SCREENS[scr].after();
  $('#prev').style.visibility = scr === 0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  $('#next').textContent = scr === SCREENS.length - 1 ? 'Guardar en mi diario' : scr === 2 && !d.zones.length ? 'Saltar' : 'Siguiente';
  $('#err').hidden = true;
}
$('#prev').onclick = () => { if (scr > 0) { scr--; save(); render(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); } };
$('#next').onclick = () => {
  const c = SCREENS[scr].check ? SCREENS[scr].check() : '';
  if (c) { $('#err').textContent = c; $('#err').hidden = false; return; }
  if (scr < SCREENS.length - 1) { scr++; save(); render(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); return; }
  diary.push({ t: Date.now(), emos: d.emos, subs: d.subs, val: d.val, int: d.int, after: d.after, zones: d.zones, sens: d.sens, needs: d.needs,
    strat: d.strat.map(x => { const k = ORDER.find(e => x.startsWith(e)); return EMO[k].strat[+x.slice(k.length)][0]; }) });
  store.set('diary', diary); d = DEF(); scr = 0; save(); render(); switchTab('diario'); toast('Guardado en tu diario');
};

// ----- Estrategias -----
let timers = [], curSt = null;
const clearT = () => { timers.forEach(t => { clearInterval(t); clearTimeout(t); }); timers = []; };
const C = 2 * Math.PI * 52;
const fmt = (s) => Math.floor(s / 60) + ':' + String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0');
function openStrat(k, i) {
  const s = EMO[k].strat[i]; curSt = k + i; clearT();
  $('#shEmo').textContent = EMO[k].name; $('#shEmo').style.color = `var(--e-${k})`; $('#shTitle').textContent = s[0]; $('#shHow').textContent = s[1];
  const g = $('#shGuide'); g.hidden = false; g.style.alignItems = ''; g.style.textAlign = ''; $('#shDone').hidden = false;
  if (s[3] === 'timer') {
    const total = s[4] * 60; let left = total, run = null;
    g.innerHTML = `<div class="ring"><svg viewBox="0 0 120 120"><circle class="track" cx="60" cy="60" r="52" fill="none" stroke-width="10"/><circle class="prog" id="rg" cx="60" cy="60" r="52" fill="none" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="${C}" stroke-dashoffset="${C}" style="opacity:0"/></svg><div class="in" id="rt">${fmt(total)}</div></div><button class="btn ghost" id="go">Empezar</button>`;
    $('#go').onclick = (e) => { if (run) { clearInterval(run); run = null; e.target.textContent = 'Seguir'; return; } e.target.textContent = 'Pausa';
      run = setInterval(() => { left--; $('#rt').textContent = left > 0 ? fmt(left) : '✓'; const r = $('#rg'); r.style.opacity = 1; r.style.strokeDashoffset = C * (left / total); if (left <= 0) { clearInterval(run); run = null; e.target.textContent = 'Hecho'; } }, 1000); timers.push(run); };
  } else if (s[3] === 'breath') {
    g.innerHTML = `<div class="breath"><div class="ball" id="ball"></div><span class="lbl2" id="bl">Listo/a</span></div><button class="btn ghost" id="go">Empezar</button>`;
    $('#go').onclick = (e) => { e.target.hidden = true; const ball = $('#ball'), L = $('#bl'); let n = 0;
      const cyc = () => { if (n >= 6) { clearT(); L.textContent = '✓'; return; } n++; ball.style.transitionDuration = '4s'; ball.style.transform = 'scale(1.15)'; L.textContent = 'Toma aire';
        timers.push(setTimeout(() => { ball.style.transitionDuration = '6s'; ball.style.transform = 'scale(.55)'; L.textContent = 'Suelta despacio'; }, 4000)); };
      cyc(); timers.push(setInterval(cyc, 10000)); };
  } else if (s[3] === 'vent') {
    g.innerHTML = `<textarea id="vt" class="vent" rows="7" placeholder="Escribe aquí todo lo que sientes. Nadie lo va a leer y no se guarda."></textarea><button class="btn ghost" id="go">Soltarlo</button><p class="muted small" id="vm">Cuando termines, pulsa «Soltarlo» y deja que se vaya.</p>`;
    $('#go').onclick = () => { const t = $('#vt'); if (!t.value.trim()) { $('#vm').textContent = 'Escribe algo primero, aunque sea una palabra.'; return; } t.classList.add('gone');
      timers.push(setTimeout(() => { t.value = ''; t.classList.remove('gone'); $('#vm').textContent = 'Ya no está aquí. Respira y nota cómo estás.'; }, 1700)); };
  } else if (s[3] === 'prompts') {
    g.innerHTML = s[4].map(q => `<div class="stack" style="width:100%;text-align:left"><span class="lbl">${esc(q)}</span><textarea rows="2"></textarea></div>`).join('') + '<p class="muted small">Esto no se guarda.</p>';
  } else { g.hidden = true; }
  $('#sheet').hidden = false; document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; $('#sheet').scrollTop = 0; $('#shClose').focus();
}

function seq(g, items, done) {
  let i = 0;
  g.innerHTML = `<div class="dots-row" style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap">${items.map(() => '<span style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent)"></span>').join('')}</div><p class="closing" id="sq"></p><button class="btn ghost" id="sqn">Hecho</button>`;
  const show = () => { g.querySelectorAll('.dots-row span').forEach((d, k) => d.style.background = k < i ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent');
    if (i >= items.length) { $('#sq').textContent = done; $('#sqn').hidden = true; return; } $('#sq').textContent = items[i]; };
  $('#sqn').onclick = () => { i++; show(); }; show();
}
function quickGuide(q) {

    g.innerHTML = `<div class="breath"><div class="ball" id="ball"></div><span class="lbl2" id="bl">Listo/a</span></div><button class="btn ghost" id="go">Empezar</button>`;

        timers.push(setTimeout(() => { ball.style.transitionDuration = '6s'; ball.style.transform = 'scale(.55)'; L.textContent = 'Suelta despacio'; }, 4000)); };
      cyc(); timers.push(setInterval(cyc, 10000)); };
  } else if (q[3] === 'timer') {
    const total = q[4] * 60; let left = total, run = null;

    $('#go').onclick = (e) => { if (run) { clearInterval(run); run = null; e.target.textContent = 'Seguir'; return; } e.target.textContent = 'Pausa';
      run = setInterval(() => { left--; $('#rt').textContent = left > 0 ? fmt(left) : '✓'; const r = $('#rg'); r.style.opacity = 1; r.style.strokeDashoffset = C * (left / total); if (left <= 0) { clearInterval(run); run = null; e.target.textContent = 'Hecho'; } }, 1000); timers.push(run); };

    seq(g, ['Nombra 5 cosas que ves', 'Nombra 4 cosas que oyes', 'Nombra 3 cosas que puedes tocar', 'Nombra 2 cosas que hueles', 'Nombra 1 cosa que saboreas'], 'Muy bien. Estás aquí, ahora.');

function quickList() {
  clearT(); curSt = null; $('#shDone').hidden = true;
  $('#shTitle').textContent = 'Bajar la intensidad';
  $('#shHow').textContent = 'Elige lo que te vaya mejor ahora. Si mirar hacia dentro te incomoda, prueba las de «fuera hacia dentro».';

  const grp = (tag, title) => `<span class="eyebrow">${title}</span>` + QUICK.map((q, i) => q[5] !== tag ? '' : `<button class="strat" style="--c:var(--accent)" data-q="${i}"><span class="ico">${I(IC[q[2]])}</span><span class="t"><b>${q[0]}</b><span>${q[1]}</span></span></button>`).join('');
  g.innerHTML = grp('cuerpo', 'Desde el cuerpo') + grp('fuera', 'De fuera hacia dentro');
  g.querySelectorAll('[data-q]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { g.style.alignItems = ''; g.style.textAlign = ''; quickGuide(QUICK[+b.dataset.q]); });
}

// ----- Diario -----
function renderDiary() {
  if (!diary.length) {
    $('#pattern').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Cuando explores tu primera emoción, aquí verás cuáles aparecen más.</div>';
    $('#zonesPat').innerHTML = ''; $('#entries').innerHTML = ''; return;
  }
  const cnt = {}; diary.forEach(e => e.emos.forEach(k => cnt[k] = (cnt[k] || 0) + 1));
  const max = Math.max(...Object.values(cnt));
  $('#pattern').innerHTML = `<div class="card"><div class="bars">${ORDER.filter(k => cnt[k]).sort((a, b) => cnt[b] - cnt[a]).map(k => `<div class="bar" style="--c:var(--e-${k})"><span>${EMO[k].name}</span><span class="tr"><span class="fl" style="display:block;width:${(cnt[k] / max) * 100}%"></span></span><b>${cnt[k]}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  const zc = {}; diary.forEach(e => (e.zones || []).forEach(z => zc[z] = (zc[z] || 0) + 1));
  const zs = Object.entries(zc).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  if (zs.length) { const top = zs.slice(0, 3).map(z => z[0]); d.zones = d.zones;
    $('#zonesPat').innerHTML = `<div class="card" style="flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:14px"><div class="mini-body" style="width:90px;flex:none">${bodySVG().replace(/class="z ([^"]*)" data-zone="([^"]+)"/g, (m, c, z) => `class="z ${top.includes(z) ? 'on' : ''}" data-zone-x="${z}"`)}</div><p>${zs.slice(0, 3).map(([z, n]) => `<b>${esc(z)}</b> (${n})`).join('<br>')}</p></div>`; }
  else $('#zonesPat').innerHTML = '<p class="muted small">Todavía no has marcado zonas del cuerpo.</p>';
  $('#entries').innerHTML = diary.slice().reverse().slice(0, 20).map(e => { const dt = new Date(e.t); const df = e.int - e.after;
    return `<div class="entry"><span class="dots">${e.emos.map(k => `<i style="--c:var(--e-${k})"></i>`).join('')}</span>
      <strong>${esc((e.subs.length ? e.subs : e.emos.map(k => EMO[k].name)).join(', '))}</strong>
      <span class="delta">${df > 0 ? '−' + df : df === 0 ? '=' : '+' + (-df)}</span>
      <span class="muted small">${dt.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} · intensidad ${e.int} → ${e.after}${e.zones.length ? ' · ' + esc(e.zones.join(', ').toLowerCase()) : ''}</span></div>`; }).join('');
}
function summary() {
  if (!diary.length) return 'Todavía no he registrado ninguna emoción.';
  const L = ['Mi diario emocional: resumen', ''];
  diary.slice(-15).forEach(e => L.push(`- ${new Date(e.t).toLocaleDateString('es-ES')}: ${(e.subs.length ? e.subs : e.emos.map(k => EMO[k].name)).join(', ')} (${e.val || '—'}), intensidad ${e.int}→${e.after}${e.zones.length ? '; cuerpo: ' + e.zones.join(', ') : ''}${e.needs.length ? '; necesitaba: ' + e.needs.join(', ') : ''}${e.strat.length ? '; me ayudó: ' + e.strat.join(', ') : ''}`));
  return L.join('\n');
}
$('#copyBtn').onclick = () => { const txt = summary(); const fb = () => { const t = $('#copyFallback'); t.value = txt; t.hidden = false; t.focus(); t.select(); toast('Selecciona y copia el texto'); };
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => toast('Resumen copiado. Pégalo en un mensaje.'), fb); } catch (e) { fb(); } };
$('#clearBtn').onclick = () => $('#clearConfirm').hidden = false;
$('#clearNo').onclick = () => $('#clearConfirm').hidden = true;
$('#clearYes').onclick = () => { diary = []; store.set('diary', []); $('#clearConfirm').hidden = true; renderDiary(); toast('Diario borrado'); };

function switchTab(v) { document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x.dataset.view === v));
  document.querySelectorAll('section.view').forEach(s => s.hidden = s.id !== 'view-' + v); if (v === 'diario') renderDiary(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); }
document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => switchTab(b.dataset.view));
if (scr >= SCREENS.length) scr = 0;
render(); renderDiary();
</script>

function door(t) {
  const style = `background:var(--c${t.c});color:var(--c${t.c}i)`, fav = favs.includes(t.id), isNew = t.nueva && !seen.includes(t.id);
  return `<div class="door" style="${style}"><a href="${t.id}/" data-go="${t.id}" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex:1;min-width:0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none">
    <span class="ico">${svg(t.ico)}</span><span class="txt">${isNew ? '<span class="new">Nueva</span>' : ''}<strong>${t.titulo}</strong><span class="d">${t.desc}</span></span></a>
    <button class="star" data-fav="${t.id}" aria-pressed="${fav}" aria-label="${fav ? 'Quitar de favoritas' : 'Añadir a favoritas'}: ${t.titulo}">${svg(STAR, 1.8)}</button></div>`;
}
function renderNeeds() {
  $('#needs').innerHTML = NEEDS.map(([k, t, ic]) => `<button class="need" data-need="${k}" aria-pressed="${need === k}"><span class="em">${svg(ic)}</span><b>${t}</b></button>`).join('');
  $$('[data-need]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { need = need === b.dataset.need ? null : b.dataset.need; q = ''; $('#q').value = ''; $('#qx').hidden = true; area = 'all'; renderNeeds(); renderList();
    if (need) $('#listBox').scrollIntoView({ behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' }); });
}
function renderTop() {
  $('#favBox').hidden = !favs.length; $('#favs').innerHTML = favs.map(id => door(byId[id])).join('');
  const rec = recent.filter(id => !favs.includes(id)).slice(0, 4); $('#recBox').hidden = !rec.length;
  $('#recent').innerHTML = rec.map(id => { const t = byId[id]; return `<a href="${t.id}/" data-go="${t.id}" style="background:var(--c${t.c});color:var(--c${t.c}i)"><span>${svg(t.ico)}</span>${t.titulo}</a>`; }).join('');
}
function renderList() {
  const box = $('#list'); $('#areas').hidden = !!(need || q);
  $('#areas').innerHTML = [['all', 'Todas', 0], ...AREAS].map(([k, n, c]) => `<button data-area="${k}" aria-pressed="${area === k}" style="--dot:var(--c${c}i)">${c ? '<i></i>' : ''}${n}</button>`).join('');
  $$('[data-area]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { area = b.dataset.area; renderList(); });
  if (q) { const w = norm(q).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), res = TOOLS.filter(t => { const hay = norm(t.titulo + ' ' + t.desc + ' ' + t.kw + ' ' + AREAS.find(a => a[0] === t.area)[1]); return w.every(x => hay.includes(x)); });
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="sec"><h2>${res.length ? `${res.length} ${res.length === 1 ? 'herramienta' : 'herramientas'} para «${esc(q)}»` : `Nada para «${esc(q)}»`}</h2>${res.length ? `<div class="doors">${res.map(door).join('')}</div>` : '<div class="empty">Prueba con otra palabra, o elige cómo estás arriba.</div>'}</div>`; bind(); return; }
  if (need) { const n = NEEDS.find(x => x[0] === need);
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="sec"><h2>Para cuando: ${n[1].charAt(0).toLowerCase() + n[1].slice(1)}</h2><p class="hint">Te propongo empezar por la primera. Si no encaja, prueba las siguientes.</p><div class="doors">${n[3].map(id => door(byId[id])).join('')}</div><button class="clear" id="clearNeed">← Ver todas las herramientas</button></div>`;
    $('#clearNeed').onclick = () => { need = null; renderNeeds(); renderList(); }; bind(); return; }
  box.innerHTML = AREAS.filter(([k]) => area === 'all' || area === k).map(([k, n, c]) => { const ts = TOOLS.filter(t => t.area === k); return ts.length ? `<div class="sec"><h2 style="--dot:var(--c${c}i)"><i></i>${n}</h2><div class="doors">${ts.map(door).join('')}</div></div>` : ''; }).join('');
  bind();
}
function bind() {
  $$('[data-fav]').forEach(b => b.onclick = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const id = b.dataset.fav; favs = favs.includes(id) ? favs.filter(x => x !== id) : [...favs, id]; store.set('favs', favs);
    const y = window.scrollY; renderTop(); renderList(); window.scrollTo(0, y); const nb = document.querySelector(`#list [data-fav="${id}"]`) || document.querySelector(`[data-fav="${id}"]`); if (nb && favs.includes(id)) nb.classList.add('pop'); });
  $$('[data-go]').forEach(a => a.onclick = () => { const id = a.dataset.go; recent = [id, ...recent.filter(x => x !== id)].slice(0, 6); store.set('recent', recent); if (!seen.includes(id)) { seen.push(id); store.set('seen', seen); } });
}
$('#q').oninput = (e) => { q = e.target.value.trim(); need = null; $('#qx').hidden = !q; renderNeeds(); renderList(); };
$('#qx').onclick = () => { q = ''; $('#q').value = ''; $('#qx').hidden = true; renderList(); $('#q').focus(); };
document.querySelector('.sos').addEventListener('click', () => { recent = ['calma', ...recent.filter(x => x !== 'calma')].slice(0, 6); store.set('recent', recent); });
const h = new Date().getHours();
$('#saludo').textContent = (h < 6 ? 'Hola, ¿noche difícil? ' : h < 14 ? 'Buenos días. ' : h < 21 ? 'Buenas tardes. ' : 'Buenas noches. ') + 'Elige lo que más se acerque a cómo estás. No hay una respuesta correcta.';
renderNeeds(); renderTop(); renderList();

let rMode = 'wait', rPlaying = false;
const TREES = [[-1, .15], [1, .35], [-1, .55], [1, .75], [-1, .95]];
function roadSVG() {
  // perspectiva: horizonte en y=60
  let g = `<defs><linearGradient id="fogG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="var(--fog)" stop-opacity="1"/><stop offset=".62" stop-color="var(--fog)" stop-opacity=".97"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="var(--fog)" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient></defs>
    <rect width="320" height="190" fill="var(--sky)"/><rect y="60" width="320" height="130" fill="color-mix(in srgb, var(--real) 25%, var(--sky))"/>
    <path d="M150 60 L170 60 L300 190 L20 190 Z" fill="var(--road)"/>
    <path class="dash" d="M160 62 L160 190" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/>`;
  g += `<g id="trees"></g>`;
  g += `<rect id="fogR" x="0" y="0" width="320" height="128" fill="url(#fogG)"/>`;
  g += `<g id="flag" opacity="0" style="transition:opacity .5s"><path d="M186 92 v-30" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M186 62 l18 6 -18 6z" fill="var(--real)"/></g>`;
  g += `<text x="160" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="var(--display)" font-size="15" fill="var(--muted)" id="fogT">¿Qué habrá más adelante?</text>`;
  g += `<g id="car" transform="translate(160 168)"><rect x="-22" y="-14" width="44" height="22" rx="7" fill="var(--car)"/><rect x="-15" y="-24" width="30" height="13" rx="5" fill="var(--car)"/><rect x="-12" y="-21" width="24" height="8" rx="3" fill="var(--sky)"/><circle cx="-14" cy="9" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="14" cy="9" r="5" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <path id="beam" d="M-14 -14 L-40 -60 L40 -60 L14 -14 Z" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0"/></g>`;
  return g;
}
function treeAt(side, p) { // p 0 (horizonte) .. 1 (abajo)
  const y = 60 + p * 130, x = 160 + side * (12 + p * 150), s = .25 + p * 1.1;
  return `<g transform="translate(${x.toFixed(1)} ${y.toFixed(1)}) scale(${s.toFixed(2)})"><rect x="-2" y="-10" width="4" height="10" fill="#7a5a3a"/><circle cx="0" cy="-18" r="11" fill="var(--real)"/></g>`;
}
function renderRoad() { $('#road').innerHTML = roadSVG(); $('#trees').innerHTML = TREES.map(([s, p]) => treeAt(s, p)).join(''); $('#km').textContent = '0 km'; $('#anx').textContent = '5/10';
  $('#rWait').setAttribute('aria-pressed', rMode === 'wait'); $('#rGo').setAttribute('aria-pressed', rMode === 'go');
  $('#rTxt').innerHTML = rMode === 'wait' ? 'Si esperas a que se vaya la niebla para arrancar, te quedas parada/o. La niebla no se va, y la ansiedad sube.' : 'Con los faros solo ves unos metros… pero es suficiente para avanzar. <b>Nunca ves todo el camino, y aun así puedes recorrerlo entero.</b>'; }
function playRoad() {
  if (rPlaying) return; rPlaying = true; renderRoad(); const t0 = performance.now(), DUR = 7000, road = $('#road');
  if (rMode === 'go') { road.classList.add('go'); $('#beam').setAttribute('opacity', .45); }
  const step = (now) => { const u = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / DUR);
    if (rMode === 'go') { const off = (u * 3) % 1; $('#trees').innerHTML = TREES.map(([s, p]) => treeAt(s, (p + off) % 1)).join('');
      $('#km').textContent = (u * 12).toFixed(1).replace('.', ',') + ' km'; $('#anx').textContent = Math.round(5 - u * 2) + '/10';
      $('#fogT').textContent = u < .9 ? 'Lo voy viendo según avanzo' : '¡He llegado!'; if (u > .9) $('#flag').setAttribute('opacity', 1); }
    else { $('#anx').textContent = Math.round(5 + u * 4) + '/10'; $('#fogT').textContent = ['¿Qué habrá más adelante?', '¿Y si hay una curva?', '¿Y si me equivoco?', 'Necesito verlo todo antes…'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(u * 4))];
      $('#car').setAttribute('transform', `translate(${160 + Math.sin(u * 40) * 1.2} 168)`); }
    if (u < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else { rPlaying = false; road.classList.remove('go'); $('#rPlay').textContent = '↻ Otra vez'; if (rMode === 'wait') toast('Ahora prueba «Avanzo con lo que veo»'); } };
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
$('#rWait').onclick = () => { if (rPlaying) return; rMode = 'wait'; renderRoad(); $('#rPlay').textContent = '▶ Ver'; };
$('#rGo').onclick = () => { if (rPlaying) return; rMode = 'go'; renderRoad(); $('#rPlay').textContent = '▶ Ver'; };

/* Cubo */
let level = 0, nChk = 0, nDoubt = 0, drainIv = null;
const DOUBTS = ['¿y si…?', '¿seguro?', '¿y si no?', '¿lo miro otra vez?', '¿y si se me pasó algo?'];
function bucketSVG() {
  const h = 110 * level / 100, y = 150 - h;
  return `<defs><clipPath id="bk"><path d="M22 40 L128 40 L116 150 L34 150 Z"/></clipPath></defs>
    <rect x="0" y="${y}" width="150" height="${h + 2}" fill="var(--water)" opacity=".75" clip-path="url(#bk)" style="transition:y .5s, height .5s"/>
    <path d="M22 40 L128 40 L116 150 L34 150 Z" fill="none" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M22 40 Q75 4 128 40" fill="none" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="75" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-family="var(--display)" font-size="14" fill="var(--deep)">certeza</text>
    <circle cx="75" cy="152" r="5" fill="var(--bg)" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2"/><g id="drops"></g>`;
}
function drawBucket() { $('#bucket').innerHTML = bucketSVG(); $('#lvl').textContent = Math.round(level) + '%'; $('#nChk').textContent = nChk; $('#nDoubt').textContent = nDoubt; }
function drip() { if (level <= 0) return; const d = $('#drops'); if (!d) return; const t = DOUBTS[nDoubt % DOUBTS.length]; nDoubt++;
  const el = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g'); el.setAttribute('class', reduce ? '' : 'drop');
  el.innerHTML = `<circle cx="75" cy="162" r="4" fill="var(--water)"/><text x="75" y="178" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="var(--doubt)" font-family="var(--body)">${t}</text>`; d.appendChild(el); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 1600);
  $('#nDoubt').textContent = nDoubt; }
$$('[data-chk]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { nChk++; level = Math.min(100, level + 45); drawBucket(); clearInterval(drainIv);
  let tick = 0; drainIv = setInterval(() => { level = Math.max(0, level - 4); tick++; const r = $('#bucket rect'); if (r) { const h = 110 * level / 100; r.setAttribute('y', 150 - h); r.setAttribute('height', h + 2); } $('#lvl').textContent = Math.round(level) + '%';

function renderX() {
  $('#xDots').innerHTML = XS.map((_, i) => `<span class="${i <= X.step ? 'on' : ''}"></span>`).join('');
  $('#xScreen').innerHTML = XS[X.step].r() + `<p class="small" id="xErr" style="color:var(--warn-ink)" hidden></p><div class="nav-row"><button class="btn link" id="xPrev" style="visibility:${X.step ?   XS[X.step].a && XS[X.step].a();
  $('#xPrev').onclick = () => { X.step--; saveX(); renderX(); };
  $('#xNext').onclick = () => { const c = XS[X.step].c ? XS[X.step].c() : ''; if (c) { $('#xErr').textContent = c; $('#xErr').hidden = false; return; }
    if (X.step < XS.length - 1) { X.step++; saveX(); renderX(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); return; }
    logs.push({ t: Date.now(), e: X.sel, pf: X.pf, rf: X.rf, res: X.res, dur: X.dur }); store.set('logs', logs);
    X = { step: 0, sel: null, txt: '', pred: [], pf: 6, res: '', rf: 3, dur: '' }; saveX(); renderX(); toast('Experimento guardado'); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); };
  renderLog();
}
function renderLog() {
  if (!logs.length) { $('#xLog').innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const n = logs.length, W = 320, H = 150, l = 24, r = 10, t = 12, b = 22, x = (i) => n === 1 ? (l + W - r) / 2 : l + i * (W - l - r) / (n - 1), y = (v) => t + (10 - v) * (H - t - b) / 10;
  let g = [0, 5, 10].map(v => `<line x1="${l}" x2="${W - r}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="var(--line)"/><text x="${l - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${v}</text>`).join('');
  [['pf', 'var(--pred)'], ['rf', 'var(--real)']].forEach(([k, c]) => { g += `<path d="${logs.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i).toFixed(1)} ${y(p[k]).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>` + logs.map((p, i) => `<circle cx="${x(i)}" cy="${y(p[k])}" r="4" fill="${c}"/>`).join(''); });
  g += logs.map((_, i) => `<text x="${x(i)}" y="${H - 6}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="var(--muted)">${i + 1}</text>`).join('');
  const avg = logs.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.pf - p.rf), 0) / n;
  $('#xLog').innerHTML = `<span class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:8px">Mis experimentos</span><div class="card"><div class="nav-row small"><span><i style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pred);margin-right:6px"></i>Esperaba</span><span><i style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--real);margin-right:6px"></i>Sentí</span></div>
    <svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Malestar esperado y real en cada experimento">${g}</svg>
    ${n >= 2 ? `<p class="small">De media, tu mente predice <b>${avg > 0 ? avg.toFixed(1).replace('.', ',') + ' puntos más' : 'lo mismo o menos'}</b> de malestar del que luego sientes.</p>` : ''}</div>` +
    logs.slice().reverse().slice(0, 6).map(p => `<div class="log"><b>${esc(p.e)}</b><span class="muted small">${new Date(p.t).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} · ${esc(p.res)}${p.dur ? ' · ' + p.dur : ''} · esperaba ${p.pf}, sentí ${p.rf}</span></div>`).join('');
}

let wpts = [], wt0 = 0, wiv = null;
function waveSVG(arr) {
  const W = 320, H = 170, l = 10, b = 16, t = 10, maxT = Math.max(180, arr.length ? arr[arr.length - 1][0] : 0), x = (s) => l + s * (W - 2 * l) / maxT, y = (v) => t + (10 - v) * (H - t - b) / 10;
  let g = `<rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="color-mix(in srgb, var(--wave) 8%, var(--surface))"/>`;
  if (arr.length) { const pts = arr.map(([s, v]) => [x(s), y(v)]); let d = `M${pts[0][0]} ${pts[0][1]}`;
    for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) { const [x0, y0] = pts[i - 1], [x1, y1] = pts[i], mx = (x0 + x1) / 2; d += ` C${mx} ${y0} ${mx} ${y1} ${x1} ${y1}`; }
    g += `<path d="${d} L${pts[pts.length - 1][0]} ${H} L${pts[0][0]} ${H} Z" fill="var(--wave)" opacity=".35"/><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(--wave)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    const [lx, ly] = pts[pts.length - 1];
    g += `<g class="surfer" transform="translate(${lx} ${ly - 4})"><path d="M-12 0 Q0 5 12 0" stroke="var(--car)" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="0" cy="-16" r="4.5" fill="var(--deep)"/><path d="M0 -11 L0 -3 M-6 -8 L6 -9" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>`; }
  else g += `<path d="M0 ${H - 40} Q40 ${H - 60} 80 ${H - 40} T160 ${H - 40} T240 ${H - 40} T320 ${H - 40} V${H} H0Z" fill="var(--wave)" opacity=".3"/><text x="${W / 2}" y="${H / 2 - 10}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--muted)" font-family="var(--body)">Aquí se dibujará tu ola</text>`;
  return g;
}

  const mx = Math.max(...wpts.map(p => p[1])), end = wpts[wpts.length - 1][1];
  $('#wMsg').innerHTML = `<div class="${end < mx ? 'ok' : 'note'} pop">${end < mx ? `Tus ganas subieron hasta <b>${mx}</b> y bajaron a <b>${end}</b> sin comprobar nada. Has surfeado la ola.` : 'La ola aún está alta. Está bien: a veces tarda más. Puedes seguir haciendo otra cosa y volver a mirarla en un rato.'}</div>`;
  const W = store.get('waves', []); W.push({ t: Date.now(), mx, end, s: wpts[wpts.length - 1][0] }); store.set('waves', W); };
const BACK = ['Seguir con lo que estaba haciendo', 'Hablar con alguien', 'Salir a dar un paseo', 'Hacer algo con las manos', 'Jugar con los peques', 'Descansar sin el móvil'];
function renderBack() { const sel = store.get('back', '');
  $('#back').innerHTML = BACK.map(b => `<button class="chip" style="--c:var(--real)" data-bk="${b}" aria-pressed="${sel === b}">${b}</button>`).join('');
  $$('[data-bk]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { store.set('back', b.dataset.bk); renderBack(); $('#backMsg').innerHTML = `<div class="ok pop">Adelante: <b>${esc(b.dataset.bk.toLowerCase())}</b>. La duda puede venir contigo; no hace falta que se vaya para que vivas.</div>`; }); }
renderBack();

function summary() {
  const L = ['Convivir con la incertidumbre: resumen'];
  if (MC.beh.length) L.push('Cómo busco certeza: ' + MC.beh.map(k => { const b = BEH.find(x => x[0] === k); return b[1] + (MC.freq[k] !== undefined ? ` (${FREQ[MC.freq[k]]} al día)` : ''); }).join(', '));
  if (MC.cost.length) L.push('Me cuesta: ' + MC.cost.join(', '));
  logs.forEach(p => L.push(`- ${new Date(p.t).toLocaleDateString('es-ES')} ${p.e}: esperaba ${p.pf}, sentí ${p.rf} (${p.res}${p.dur ? ', ' + p.dur : ''})`));
  const W = store.get('waves', []); if (W.length) L.push(`Olas surfeadas: ${W.length} (ganas de ${W[W.length - 1].mx} a ${W[W.length - 1].end} la última vez)`);
  if (fav !== null) L.push('Mi frase: ' + PHR[fav]);
  return L.join('\n');
}
$('#copyBtn').onclick = () => { const txt = summary(); const fb = () => { const t = $('#copyFallback'); t.value = txt; t.hidden = false; t.focus(); t.select(); toast('Selecciona y copia el texto'); setTimeout(() => t.hidden = true, 15000); };
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => toast('Copiado. Pégalo en un mensaje.'), fb); } catch (e) { fb(); } };

function switchTab(v) {
  $$('nav.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x.dataset.view === v)); $$('section.view').forEach(s => s.hidden = s.id !== 'view-' + v);
  if (v === 'mis') renderMis(); if (v === 'exp') renderX();
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
}
$$('nav.tabs button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => switchTab(b.dataset.view));
</script>

function houseSVG(kind) {
  let extra = '';
  if (kind === 'nada') extra = '<g stroke="var(--muted)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 22l12 10M92 20l-12 10M6 50h14M94 52H80"/></g>';
  if (kind === 'valla') extra = '<g fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 80V64l4-5 4 5v16zM22 80V64l4-5 4 5v16zM34 80V64l4-5 4 5v16zM58 80V64l4-5 4 5v16zM70 80V64l4-5 4 5v16zM82 80V64l4-5 4 5v16z"/></g><path d="M44 80l-6 4V66l6-4z" fill="var(--warm)" stroke="var(--warm-ink)" stroke-width="2"/>';
  if (kind === 'muro') extra = '<rect x="6" y="34" width="88" height="48" rx="4" fill="var(--muted)" opacity=".85"/><g stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".6"><path d="M6 46h88M6 58h88M6 70h88M28 34v12M58 34v12M42 46v12M74 46v12M28 58v12M58 58v12M42 70v12M74 70v12"/></g>';
  const house = '<g><rect x="34" y="44" width="32" height="30" rx="3" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M28 46l22-20 22 20z" fill="var(--accent)" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="45" y="58" width="10" height="16" rx="2" fill="var(--tint)"/></g>';
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 92" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="46" ry="7" fill="var(--line)"/>${kind === 'muro' ? house + extra : house + extra}</svg>`;
}

const joinY = (a) => a.length <= 1 ? (a[0] || '') : a.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' y ' + a[a.length - 1];

const DEFAULT = () => ({ house: '', light: '', signals: [], situation: '', who: '', area: '', frenos: [], siento: [], necesito: [], accion: '', frase: '', dificultad: 4, temo: [], temoOtro: '', ensayos: 0 });
let draft = Object.assign(DEFAULT(), store.get('draft', {}) || {});
['signals', 'frenos', 'siento', 'necesito', 'temo'].forEach(k => { if (!Array.isArray(draft[k])) draft[k] = []; });
let step = store.get('step', 0);

const saveDraft = () => { store.set('draft', draft); store.set('step', step); };
const chipsHTML = (arr, sel, key, icons) => arr.map(x => `<button class="chip ${icons ? 'ichip' : ''}" data-${key}="${esc(x)}" aria-pressed="${Array.isArray(sel) ? sel.includes(x) : sel === x}">${icons && icons[x] ? I(icons[x]) : ''}${esc(x)}</button>`).join('');
function bindMulti(key, field, cb) {
  document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${key}]`).forEach(x => x.onclick = () => { const v = x.getAttribute('data-' + key);
    draft[field] = draft[field].includes(v) ? draft[field].filter(y => y !== v) : [...draft[field], v];
    x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', draft[field].includes(v)); saveDraft(); cb && cb(); });
}
function suggestions() {
  const out = [];
  const nec = draft.necesito.length ? joinY(draft.necesito) : '';
  const sie = draft.siento.length ? joinY(draft.siento) : '';
  const acc = draft.accion.trim().replace(/\.$/, '');
  if (acc && nec) out.push(`Necesito ${nec}. Por eso, voy a ${acc}.`);
  else if (acc) out.push(`Esta vez voy a ${acc}.`);
  if (sie && nec) out.push(`Últimamente me siento ${sie}. Necesito ${nec}, así que esta vez no puedo.`);
  out.push('Gracias por contar conmigo, pero esta vez no puedo.');
  out.push('Déjame pensarlo y te digo.');
  return out.slice(0, 3);
}

function fenceSVG() {
  const n = STEPS.length, w = 300, gap = w / (n + 1);
  let g = `<line x1="6" y1="30" x2="${w - 6}" y2="30" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="6" y1="44" x2="${w - 6}" y2="44" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const x = gap * (i + 1) - 8, on = i <= step, cur = i === step;
    const last = i === n - 1;
    if (last) g += `<rect x="${x - 2}" y="14" width="20" height="40" rx="3" class="${on ? 'p-on' : 'p-off'} ${cur ? 'p-cur' : ''}"/><circle cx="${x + 13}" cy="36" r="1.8" fill="${on ? 'var(--surface)' : 'var(--line)'}"/>`;
    else g += `<path d="M${x} 56V18l8-9 8 9v38z" class="${on ? 'p-on' : 'p-off'} ${cur ? 'p-cur' : ''}"/>`;
  }
  return `<svg class="fence" viewBox="0 0 ${w} 62" role="img" aria-label="Paso ${step + 1} de ${n}">${g}</svg>`;
}

function renderStep() {
  const s = STEPS[step];
  $('#progress').innerHTML = fenceSVG();
  $('#stepBox').innerHTML = `<span class="eyebrow">Paso ${step + 1} de ${STEPS.length}</span><div class="step-head"><div class="ico">${I(ICONS[s.icon])}</div><h1>${s.title}</h1></div>${SPOTS[step] ? `<div class="spot">${SPOTS[step]}</div>` : ''}${s.render()}`;
  s.after && s.after();
  $('#prevBtn').style.visibility = step === 0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  $('#nextBtn').textContent = step === STEPS.length - 1 ? 'Guardar mi límite' : 'Siguiente';
  $('#stepErr').hidden = true;
}
$('#prevBtn').onclick = () => { if (step > 0) { step--; saveDraft(); renderStep(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); } };
$('#nextBtn').onclick = () => {
  const err = STEPS[step].check ? STEPS[step].check() : '';
  if (err) { $('#stepErr').textContent = err; $('#stepErr').hidden = false; return; }
  if (step < STEPS.length - 1) { step++; saveDraft(); renderStep(); window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); return; }
  plans.push({ ...draft, id: Date.now(), creado: Date.now(), estado: 'pendiente' });
  store.set('plans', plans);
  const h = draft.house; draft = DEFAULT(); draft.house = h;
  step = 1; saveDraft(); renderStep(); renderMis(); switchTab('mis'); toast('Límite guardado en tu escalera');
};

function copyText(txt, ok) {
  const fb = () => { const t = $('#copyFallback'); t.value = txt; t.hidden = false; switchTab('mis'); t.focus(); t.select(); toast('Selecciona y copia el texto'); };
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => toast(ok), fb); } catch (e) { fb(); }
}
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { const c = e.target.closest('[data-copy]'); if (c) copyText(PHRASES[+c.dataset.copy][1], 'Frase copiada'); });

// Mis límites
const STAIR_COLORS = ['#A9C6CD', '#8DB5BF', '#5C9AA9', '#2A7387', '#166A7E', '#0F4C5C'];
function renderMis() {
  const pend = plans.filter(p => p.estado === 'pendiente').sort((a, b) => a.dificultad - b.dificultad);
  if (!plans.length) {
    $('#stairs').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Cuando prepares tu primer límite en «Paso a paso», aparecerá aquí como un peldaño de tu escalera.</div>';
    $('#plans').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const st = pend.slice(0, 6);
  $('#stairs').innerHTML = st.length ? `<div class="stairs-box"><div class="stairs">${st.map((p, i) => `<div class="stair" style="height:${30 + (p.dificultad / 10) * 110}px;background:${STAIR_COLORS[Math.min(i, 5)]}">${i === 0 ? '<svg class="walker" viewBox="0 0 24 34" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="4" fill="var(--deep)"/><path d="M12 10v12M12 22l-5 10M12 22l5 10M6 15l6-3 6 3" stroke="var(--deep)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></svg>' : ''}${i + 1}<small>${esc(p.who || p.area || p.situation.slice(0, 24))}</small></div>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <p class="hint">Ordenados de menos a más difícil. Empieza por el 1.</p>` : '<div class="empty">No tienes límites pendientes. ¡Todos los que preparaste ya los has puesto!</div>';
  $('#plans').innerHTML = plans.slice().reverse().map(p => `<div class="plan">
      <div class="meta"><span class="pill ${p.estado === 'hecho' ? 'done' : 'pend'}">${p.estado === 'hecho' ? 'Puesto' : 'Pendiente'}</span><span class="pill">Dificultad ${p.dificultad}/10</span>${p.area ? `<span class="pill">${esc(p.area)}</span>` : ''}</div>
      <p class="small muted">${esc(p.situation)}${p.who ? ' · con ' + esc(p.who) : ''}</p>
      <q>${esc(p.frase)}</q>
      ${p.estado === 'hecho' ? `<p class="small"><b>Reacción:</b> ${esc(p.reaccion || '—')} · <b>Culpa/malestar después:</b> ${p.despues}/10</p>${p.real ? `<p class="small muted">${esc(p.real)}</p>` : ''}` : ''}
      <div class="acts">${p.estado === 'pendiente' ? `<button class="btn small" data-done="${p.id}">Ya lo he puesto</button>` : ''}<button class="btn link small" data-del="${p.id}">Borrar</button></div>
      <div class="feedback" data-delc="${p.id}" hidden>¿Borrar este límite? <button class="btn small" data-dely="${p.id}">Sí, borrar</button> <button class="btn link small" data-deln="${p.id}">Cancelar</button></div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
let cur = null, curReact = '';
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const d = e.target.closest('[data-done]'); if (d) { openSheet(+d.dataset.done); return; }
  const x = e.target.closest('[data-del]'); if (x) { document.querySelector(`[data-delc="${x.dataset.del}"]`).hidden = false; return; }
  const n = e.target.closest('[data-deln]'); if (n) { document.querySelector(`[data-delc="${n.dataset.deln}"]`).hidden = true; return; }
  const y = e.target.closest('[data-dely]'); if (y) { plans = plans.filter(p => p.id !== +y.dataset.dely); store.set('plans', plans); renderMis(); toast('Borrado'); }
});
function openSheet(id) {
  cur = plans.find(p => p.id === id); curReact = '';
  $('#shPhrase').textContent = cur.frase; $('#shReal').value = ''; $('#shFeel').value = 4; $('#shFeelVal').textContent = 4; $('#reactTip').hidden = true;
  const tem = [...(cur.temo || []), cur.temoOtro].filter(Boolean); $('#shReal').placeholder = tem.length ? `Temías: ${joinY(tem)}. ¿Qué pasó de verdad?` : 'Por ejemplo: temía que se enfadara mucho y solo dijo «vale»';
  $('#reactChips').innerHTML = REACTIONS.map(([r], i) => `<button class="chip" data-react="${i}" aria-pressed="false">${esc(r)}</button>`).join('');
  const art = document.querySelector('.gate'); const c = art.cloneNode(true); art.replaceWith(c);
  $('#sheet').hidden = false; document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; $('#sheet').scrollTop = 0; $('#shClose').focus();
}
$('#reactChips').addEventListener('click', (e) => { const c = e.target.closest('[data-react]'); if (!c) return; const r = REACTIONS[+c.dataset.react]; curReact = r[0];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-react]').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === c)); $('#reactTip').hidden = false; $('#reactTip').innerHTML = `<b>Qué puedes hacer</b>${esc(r[1])}`; });
$('#shFeel').oninput = (e) => $('#shFeelVal').textContent = e.target.value;
const closeSheet = () => { $('#sheet').hidden = true; document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
$('#shClose').onclick = closeSheet;
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && !$('#sheet').hidden) closeSheet(); });
$('#shSave').onclick = () => { Object.assign(cur, { estado: 'hecho', reaccion: curReact, real: $('#shReal').value, despues: +$('#shFeel').value, puesto: Date.now() }); store.set('plans', plans); closeSheet(); renderMis(); toast('Guardado. ¡Un peldaño más!'); };

function summary() {
  if (!plans.length) return 'Todavía no he preparado ningún límite.';
  const L = ['Mis límites: resumen', ''];
  plans.forEach(p => {
    L.push(`- ${p.estado === 'hecho' ? '[Puesto]' : '[Pendiente]'} ${p.situation}${p.who ? ' (con ' + p.who + ')' : ''}`);
    L.push(`  Frase: «${p.frase}» · Dificultad ${p.dificultad}/10${p.frenos.length ? ' · Frenos: ' + p.frenos.join(', ') : ''}${(p.necesito || []).length ? ' · Necesito: ' + p.necesito.join(', ') : ''}`);
    if (p.estado === 'hecho') L.push(`  Reacción: ${p.reaccion || '—'} · Culpa/malestar después: ${p.despues}/10${p.real ? ' · ' + p.real : ''}`);
  });
  return L.join('\n');
}
$('#copyBtn').onclick = () => copyText(summary(), 'Resumen copiado. Pégalo en un mensaje.');

function switchTab(v) {
  document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x.dataset.view === v));
  document.querySelectorAll('section.view').forEach(s => s.hidden = s.id !== 'view-' + v);
  if (v === 'mis') renderMis();
}
document.querySelectorAll('nav.tabs button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => switchTab(b.dataset.view));
renderStep(); renderMis();
</script>
